websiteDevelopment.metaDescription: Custom, fast, bilingual website development for Saudi businesses. Built in Arabic and English, SEO ready, and designed to convert visitors into customers.

includes.text: A design shaped around your brand and audience, not a recycled template.

faqs.q: How long does a website take?
faqs.a: Most business websites take three to six weeks depending on the number of pages and features. We give you a clear timeline before we start.

faqs.q: Will my website work in Arabic?
faqs.a: Yes. We build in Arabic and English with full right to left support, so both versions feel natural.

faqs.q: Can I update the site myself?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build on a content system that lets your team edit text and images without a developer.

faqs.q: Do you provide hosting?
faqs.a: We help you set up fast, reliable hosting and can manage it for you if you prefer.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take?
faqs.a: SEO is a medium term investment. Early gains can appear within a few months, with stronger results building over time.

faqs.q: Do you do Arabic SEO?
faqs.a: Yes. We optimize for Arabic and English searches, which behave differently and need separate care.

faqs.q: Can you help with local rankings?
faqs.a: Yes. Local SEO is a core focus, including Google Business Profile and city level targeting.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee first place?
faqs.a: No honest agency can guarantee a specific ranking. We focus on steady, real improvement you can measure.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Forge Arabia is a digital transformation company based in Ar Rass, Al Qassim, serving businesses across Saudi Arabia with technology, marketing, and AI automation.
aboutPage.title: About Forge Arabia
aboutPage.lead: We are a digital transformation partner based in Ar Rass, Al Qassim, helping Saudi businesses grow through technology, marketing, and AI automation.
aboutPage.story1: Forge Arabia began with a simple observation. Most Saudi businesses are served by agencies that do one thing well and the rest poorly. A company might have a good website but weak marketing, or strong campaigns pointing at a site that does not convert.
aboutPage.story2: We built Forge Arabia to close that gap. From our base in Al Qassim, we bring engineering, marketing, and AI automation together under one roof, so the work is joined up and accountable to real business results.
aboutPage.mission: To help Saudi businesses grow online with work that looks premium, performs in the market, and gives their teams time back.
aboutPage.vision: To be the digital partner Saudi businesses trust as the Kingdom moves toward a connected, diversified economy.
aboutPage.market1: We are a Saudi based team, and it shapes everything we do. We deliver in Arabic and English, understand how local customers search and buy, and design for the way business is done here.
aboutPage.market2: From Ar Rass and the wider Qassim region to Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, we work with businesses across the Kingdom.
aboutPage.positioningTitle: Technology, marketing, and AI in one team
aboutPage.positioning: Our strength is the combination. Engineers, designers, marketers, and automation specialists working together means fewer handoffs, clearer accountability, and digital work that actually moves your business forward.
aboutPage.teamLead: Our founding team is supported by specialists across development, design, marketing, and automation. Together we are a team of seven.

privacy.metaDescription: How Forge Arabia collects, uses, and protects your information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Forge Arabia collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our website or contact us. Forge Arabia is based in Ar Rass, Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: When you contact us through our website, we collect the details you provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, and the message you send.
If you browse the site, we may also collect basic technical information such as your device type and the pages you visit.

sections.title: How we use your information
body: We use your information to respond to your enquiry, provide the services you ask about, improve our website, and communicate with you about your project.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: How we share information
body: We share information only with the service providers we use to run our business, such as our email delivery provider and website hosting. These providers process data on our behalf and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: Our website may use cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: Data retention
body: We keep your information only as long as needed to respond to your enquiry and to meet our legal and business requirements.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you. To make a request, contact us using the details below.

privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this policy, contact us at {email} or {phone}.
